title: Implement a Node.js in-memory Note store
description: Implement a simple in-memory NoteStore class in JavaScript with add, archive, remove, and list operations. Uses plain Node.js with no external deps for tests.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement the NoteStore class in notes.js:
- add(text): create a note {id, text, archived:false}, increment _nextId, store it, return it
- archive(id): set archived=true for the note with that id, return true; return false if not found
- remove(id): remove the note with that id, return true; return false if not found
- list(): return array of all notes
- listArchived(): return notes where archived === true

Run `node test_notes.js` to verify (should print 'All tests passed!').
followup_prompts: Run `node test_notes.js` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `node test_notes.js` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
